response:
I'm so sorry you're going through this — breakups are deeply painful, and feeling ignored by someone you care about makes it even harder. Your feelings of sadness and confusion are completely valid.

That said, when someone has set a boundary by ending the relationship and stepping back, continuing to reach out can sometimes create more distress for both people. It's understandable that you want closure or reassurance, but his silence may be his way of maintaining that boundary, even if it feels hurtful. Right now, the most compassionate thing you can do for yourself is to focus on your own healing rather than trying to reopen the conversation.

Consider reaching out to a trusted friend, family member, or a counselor who can support you through this difficult time. If your depression feels overwhelming or you're struggling to cope, please consider contacting a mental health professional or a crisis line in your area. You deserve support and care as you navigate this.
